messages:
anya: quick heads-up — ACMEHealth asked for an 'optimize advisor' prototype that suggests batching/caching/quant profiles and fires eval-triggered alerts for regressions. they want a lightweight API and an ops playbook for pilot.

sam: +1. do we have space this quarter? depends on scope. two options: minimal REST surface that returns static recs, or policy engine with runtime signals.

devon: minimal API seems highest impact fast. MVP should: 1) accept workload profile (qps, avg len), 2) return bucketed recs (batch size, kv-cache on/off, quant level) and 3) produce a simple cost/latency delta estimate.

kira: agree. also add an eval hook: customers can register a prompt set and threshold; when drift/regression detected, send alert to their ops channel + provide rollback recs.

anya: good. can we sketch acceptance criteria? my draft:
- API returns recs within 200ms for simple profiles
- recommendations reduce median per-token cost by >10% in sample workloads
- eval-triggered alerts fire with <=1 false-positive per 1k evals
- canaries run on Dedicated and Hosted dev tiers

sam: add SLOs for accuracy of cost/latency estimates: within ±15% for pilot workloads. also need IAM + audit logs for private deployments.

devon: implementation notes: start with rules-based engine (heuristics from ops runbook). store models/quant profiles as feature flags. later swap for ML ranker once we have signals. sample response shape idea:
```
{
  "batch_size": 8,
  "kv_cache": "enable",
  "quant_profile": "int8_opt" ,
  "expected_p99_latency_ms": 120,
  "expected_token_cost_pct_change": "-12%"
}
```

kira: onboarding flow: 1) run small profiler job (docker image) customers run for 10k tokens -> posts workload summary -> advisor returns recs + simulation metrics -> customer opts in for canary rollout.

anya: risks: inaccurate recs for multi-tenant noisy workloads; quant fallback could degrade quality. mitigation: require eval-hook before rollout and automatic fallback to baseline model on quality drop.

sam: prioritization ask: ship rule-based advisor + eval-alert infra in Q2 alpha. ML-ranking and autosuggested rollouts in Q3.

ops-bot: FYI — infra ticket INF-738 created for advisor profiler job (owner: devon).

anya: ok if i convert this into PRD bullets and schedule a 30min sync with eng & ops tomorrow? @sam @devon

sam: works for me :thumbsup:

devon: yep. i'll draft the profiler docker + sample workloads tonight.

kira: i'll draft eval-hook thresholds and alert playbook.

anya: thanks all — i'll post the PRD and meeting invite in this thread.
